answer: Tournament brackets stop bulk fakes. A newcomer plays one thread of three matches against random incumbents; one loss knocks it off the ledge, while three wins earn an ivory seat. Entries cost 20 credits; each match needs a live operator in 5 minutes, so one operator plays one thread. Scripted fakes win once in eight tries, so 1,000 need 8,000 entries: 160,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full share.
